method.exact_key: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted(keys), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) encoded utf-8
method.key_definition: key = the slot id exactly as printed in the blueprint H3 heading `### `Set:ID`｜Name` that sits inside the set's declared line range (set name + ':' + id suffix, backticks stripped, no renumbering, no padding). A row exists only where the source carries such an H3 heading; nothing is inferred, padded or merged. Sorting is Python str (code-point) order over the set's keys. The combined digest applies the same rule to the union of all five sets' keys (485 keys). Duplicate product NAMES are not duplicate keys: L6228 `同名工具可以滿足多Need，但不可刪原槽` keeps them as separate slots.

gaps: count check: declared == named on all five sets (delta 0 each); total 485 named for 485 declared. No set is short of its declared count, and no set carries extra unnamed rows — every declared slot has exactly one H3 heading in the source. This is the only place the count question is answered; the entries below are shape caveats, not shortfalls.

Donor24: 6 Need name(s) repeat across slots (e.g. Fission-AI OpenSpec x4, GitHub Spec Kit x4, mattpocock skills x4, GSD x4) — per L6228 `同名工具可以滿足多Need，但不可刪原槽`, so these are distinct slots, not duplicates to collapse
Method25: 1 Need name(s) repeat across slots (e.g. mattpocock skills x4) — per L6228 `同名工具可以滿足多Need，但不可刪原槽`, so these are distinct slots, not duplicates to collapse
TECH386: 19 slot id(s) carry a bare number instead of the set's prefixed form (L8833 `TECH386:341` .. L9211 `TECH386:359`); id preserved verbatim

TECH386: 38 Need name(s) repeat across slots (e.g. mattpocock skills x3, Fission-AI OpenSpec x3, GitHub Spec Kit x5, obra Superpowers x5) — per L6228 `同名工具可以滿足多Need，但不可刪原槽`, so these are distinct slots, not duplicates to collapse

cross-set id reuse: 30 id suffix(es) appear under two set prefixes (colliding rows: Default30=30, TECH386=30); e.g. `Default30:P0-TOOL-001` and `TECH386:P0-TOOL-001` are different keys over the same underlying id. Keys stay unique (485/485), but distinct id suffixes are only 455: any de-duplication by id suffix would report 455 slots instead of 485.

118 row(s) present the source's inline `upstream=…; disposition=…` form in the disposition field instead of one token (72 of them contain `disposition=`); first: L10597 `TECH386:P0-TOOL-001`. These are recorded verbatim, so the field is comparable by prefix only.

5 of those disposition values are cut mid-token in the blueprint itself — L10607 reads `disposition=DEFAULT_ENABLED_AFTER_Q；` and L10628 reads `disposition=DEFAULT_ENABLED_AFTER_QUALIFICA；` (`TECH386:P0-TOOL-001` / `TECH386:P0-TOOL-002`). The missing tail is not reconstructed here.
